base_candidates_ranked.reason: The study uses untargeted DDA (top 10 ions) and quantifies relative levels using peak area ratios to an internal standard (bovine insulin), which is a form of label-free quantification.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment specifically analyzes endogenous plasma peptides using a 'no-digest' setting in PEAKS software to match peptides up to 65 amino acids.
